title: Entheon Hadeon Cap
description:
Entheon Stubby Cap Kit

Includes Four Different Caps available stubby fitment.

- Black Delrin

- White Delrin

- Ultem

- Clear (PCTG)

Entheon Clear Cap Kit

Includes One Full Sized Entheon Cap with 510 Integral Adapter and Colored O-Ring Set

- Blue

- Green

- Red

- Purple

- Orange

Entheon Ring Kit

Includes Four Different Rings (22mm/24.5mm)

- Black Delrin

- White Delrin

- Ultem

- Clear (PCTG)

Entheon Wide Wore Drip Tips

Includes Three Colours of Wide Bore Drip Tip

- Black Delrin

- Clear (PCTG)

- Ultem

Hadeon Caps

Includes One Hadeon cap for a more restricted airflow much like the Hadaly.

Availible in:

- Clear Acrylic (with plugs)

- Black Delrin (with plugs)
